claim.claim-text: 1. A knitted upper (11) for an article of footwear (51), formed essentially as a single piece in a three-dimensional knitting process and comprising at least one activated shrink yarn, wherein the activated shrink yarn is arranged at least in a toe portion of the upper (11).
2. The knitted upper (11) according to the preceding claim, wherein the shrink yarn comprises at least one air-tack yarn.
3. The knitted upper (11) according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the activated shrink yarn is further arranged at least in a heel portion of the upper (11).
4. The knitted upper (11) according to one of the preceding claims, comprising:

(a) a first region (R1) comprising a first number of knitted layers, (b) a second region (R2) comprising a second number of knitted layers, wherein the second number of knitted layers is larger than the first number of knitted layers.
5. The knitted upper (11) according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the knitted upper (11) is essentially seamless.

6. The knitted upper (11) according to one of the claims 4 or 5, wherein at least one of the first region (R1) and the second region (R2) comprises at least two portions, wherein a first portion comprises a yarn of a first type and wherein a second portion comprises a yarn of a second type.

7. The knitted upper (11) according to one of the preceding claims, wherein the knitted upper (11) comprises at least a first yarn and a second yarn, wherein a number of plies of the second yarn is greater than a number of plies of the first yarn.
8. The knitted upper (11) according to the preceding claim, wherein the number of plies of the second yarn is at least twice as large as the number of plies of the first yarn.

9. The knitted upper (11) according to one of the claims 4 to 8, wherein at least one of the first region (R1) and the second region (R2) comprises at least two parts, wherein a first part comprises a first knitting structure and a second part comprises a second knitting structure.
10. The knitted upper (11) according to one of the claims 4 to 9, wherein the first region (R1) comprises one knitted layer and the second region (R2) comprises two knitted layers.
(a) an upper (11) according to one of the preceding claims, (b) a sole (52).

12. A method of producing a knitted upper (11) according to one of claims 1 - 11 for an article of footwear (51), comprising: knitting at least one activable shrink yarn into the upper (11), knitting the upper (11) essentially as a single piece in a three-dimensional knitting process, wherein the activated shrink yarn is arranged at least in a toe portion of the upper (11), arranging the knitted upper (11) on a shoe last (61), and activating upper (11) the shrink yarn.

13. The method according to the preceding claim, wherein activating the shrink yarn comprises upper (11) heating the knitted upper (11) by applying to the knitted upper (11) saturated steam at a pressure between 1 bar and 5 bar for a time interval between 10 seconds and 20 seconds.
14. The method according to one of claims 12 or 13, wherein the activable shrink yarn comprises at least one air-tack yarn.
15. The method according to one of claims 12 to 14, wherein the knitting is performed on a flatbed knitting machine comprising at least two needle beds.
